name: Laikou Mung Bean Mud Mask 5g x 6 Pack
description:
Laikou Mung Bean Mud Mask – 5g x 6 Pack

🌱 Deep Cleansing | Acne Control | Oil Balance

Product Type: Facial Mud Mask
Volume: 5g x 6 Pack (Total 30g)
Origin: Made in China

Key Benefits:

Deep Cleansing: Mung bean extract cleans pores thoroughly, removing blackheads, whiteheads, and dead skin cells.

Acne Control: Helps reduce and prevent acne breakouts, leaving skin clear and smooth.

Oil Balance: Regulates excess oil secretion and prevents shine, keeping skin matte and healthy.

Brightening Effect: Improves skin texture and leaves a fresh, glowing complexion.

Pore Care: Cleanses deeply while minimizing pores.

Features:

✔ Convenient individual 5g packs – travel-friendly and easy to use
✔ Suitable for oily & acne-prone skin
✔ Can be used 2–3 times a week for best results
✔ Dermatologist-tested

✅ Best For: Acne-prone skin, blackheads, excess oil, clogged pores, dull skin
✅ Unisex: Suitable for both men & women
